keepers.slogan: Leave a light. Leave them wild.

plain.slogan: No seal. The minute is stuck.

reports.text: The east road is Route 1. The watch walks the street at dusk, lantern in hand.
The east gate is holding. Someone left a thermos on the post for the watch.
Rook is at the east gate, waving at anyone who looks lost.
The north trail can wait. The ferns are thick, and the moss is wet this week.
The north trail is open, and time feels thick. Bring a snack and walk slowly.
Keeper1 is live. The wires stay with the watch. Ask them if yours goes quiet.
A mint vest was seen on the street. The paper here is still Keeper paper.
The Trial Hall is latched. Fen is outside, pacing by the steps.
The Trial Hall is open. The steps were swept this morning.
Route 2 is under the rockslide. The crews are clearing it stone by stone.
Route 2 is open toward Wickerglen. Mind the loose gravel past the bend.
A Glimmerwell stand is on the main street. It is not the town.
Cairnside Supplies is chalked on the stall. Rope, lamp oil, and warm bread.
The quarry road is watched. Walk it in daylight, and say hello to the guard.
Hale's door has a chalk note about the quarry meeting. Tea after, at the cairn.
Cairnside Supplies is chalked on a brighter stall. The bread is still warm.
The quarry is a partnership, the cairn is still the cairn, and visitors are welcome briefly.
Hale's door has a bright chalk note about the quarry meeting. Mint pens provided.
The plaza is open. The south gate is the coach home. It leaves at every bell.
The Event Hall is taking games. Sign the sheet by the door.
The sky-dock keeps its own boarding board. This post is the town's.
The Lantern Market is south of this post. Follow the smell of roasted nuts.
The lens remembers. The minute does not move.
Someone woke. The path did not.

weather.text: Rain damps the post. Snow fogs the sleeve. Night curls the star-chart.

flyer.text: Comfort lighting, complimentary. Have a bright day at Juniper's stand.
